details: I’m a doctor who transitioned into software engineering, with five years of experience in full-stack web development using TypeScript, JavaScript, and Rust.
I’ve had the opportunity to work with both local and international companies, delivering impactful and innovative solutions.
Currently, I’m a Full-Stack developer at Had For Communications & IT, with a focus on backend development.
I also contribute to open-source Rust projects, such as Cosdata, where I’m advancing my expertise in low-level software development.
